a-length-is-out-of-bound: A length is out of bounds.
a-terrace-is-not-closed-or-an-endpoint-t: A terrace is not closed or an endpoint type is not defined
add-gate-content: Add a gate to the line, its position and width can be adjusted after its creation.
add-ladder-content: Add a ladder to the line, its position and type can be adjusted after its creation.
add-door-content: Add a door or window to the line, its position and width can be adjusted after its creation.
an-angle-is-out-of-bound: An angle is out of bounds
datapoint-content: Add a new height point to the line, clicking the tick to confirm. Its position can be adjusted after its creation.
parapet-height-content: Add a parapet height to the line, clicking the tick to confirm.
datum-content: Select if the start of the line is the starting point of the terrace material.
dp-content: Edit the height of the point, clicking the tick to confirm, or delete the point. Its position can be adjusted by the clicking and holding the left mouse button whilst dragging it or using the arrow keys.
draw-dpline-content: Use this tool to connect two points together, by clicking on one after another.
draw-line-content: Use this tool to draw multiple straight lines freely. Click on the Selector tool to stop drawing.
draw-rectangle-content: Use this tool to draw rectangles.
edit-gate-content: Change the width of the gate, delete it or adjust its position by the clicking and holding the left mouse button whilst dragging it or using the arrow keys.
edit-fixed-gate-content: Delete it or adjust its position by the clicking and holding the left mouse button whilst dragging it or using the arrow keys.
edit-door-content: Enter the width of the door or window, clicking the tick to confirm, delete it or adjust its position by the clicking and holding the left mouse button whilst dragging it or using the arrow keys.
edit-point-content: Edit the height of the point, clicking the tick to confirm. To move the point use the selector tool. This point cannot be deleted.
edit-content: Edit the length and the angle at the start of the line, clicking the tick to confirm.
edit-ladder-content: Change the type of the ladder, delete it or adjust its position by the clicking and holding the left mouse button whilst dragging it or using the arrow keys.
edit-fixed-ladder-content: Change the type of the ladder, delete it or adjust its position by the clicking and holding the left mouse button whilst dragging it or using the arrow keys.
invert-inside-outside-content: Reverse the inside and the outside of the line.
optimize-content: Optimise the counterweights and rail lengths.
parapet-content: Confirm if there is a parapet higher than 50mm present on the edge.
plinth-content: Confirm if a plinth is needed.
pointer-content: Use this tool to select and manipulate existing lines, corners and points.
reset-content: Clears all information from the drawer.
slope-content: Confirm the slope of the roof (towards the edge) is within the acceptable limit.
postalCode-content: Enter a postal code to find a specific location
address-content: Enter an address to find a specific location
export-dxf-content: Export the current drawing as a DXF file
divide-line: Divide line by adding a point
